status: Preregistered; closed heldout assets remain unexecuted until candidate/controller/weight freeze
start: Actual tabletop open-hand episode; uninterrupted physical acquisition/hold/operation
candidate: Select/freeze once using developmental behavior before opening heldout results; identical checkpoint and controller for all heldout conditions, nominal known geometry and once-loaded calibration; no asset-ID input

core.scope: Joint physical geometry + slider location + friction + placement/calibration errors + joint sensor noise/bias + one-control-step latency. 8 actual36s episodes; no outcome-based filtering.

engineering_capacity.scope: 4 further actualTABLE episodes. Separate engineering added-load amplitudes from actual summed force and real unmeasured total resistance.

sensitivity: Use predefined height-offset heldout assets if present; explicitly state actual offsets after freeze rather than silently declaring ±1mm coverage. Any absent case requires a declared separate sensitivity condition.
validity: Only predeclared physical geometry/task-validity rejection permitted; record rejected, pickup, handover, contact, load, return and body-stability failures. No post-success selection.
evidence: actual continuous video for representative success and representative failures, including all stages
separate exact-contact-pair solver diagnostics in single-G2 renderer from batched proximity/net-contact proxy
limits: Representative independent challenge, not statistically reliable full-range robustness; all511+ training geometry checks remain developmental.
